global_summary_cn: 全球流动性状态：流动性处于中性偏紧缩状态。宏观数据显示，尽管美联储降息预期趋势偏鸽派（有助风险资产），但美元指数(DXY)走强和美债收益率上升预示着流动性并非完全宽松。然而，市场叙事却极度乐观，机构资金流入（首日ETF流入$6.46亿）以及地缘政治风险溢价（委内瑞拉局势）推动了比特币和以太坊创出新高。这种流动性紧缩与叙事极度乐观的“背离”状态，使市场处于高度超买（RSI普遍高于75）和高杠杆（高资金费率）的危险境地。虽然长期基本面强劲，但短期内市场极有可能出现去杠杆化回调，以消化FOMO情绪和过度持仓。当前环境应保持谨慎，警惕抛售回调。
global_summary_en: Global liquidity is Neutral to Mildly Tightening, indicated by a strong DXY and rising US10Y, despite dovish Fed rate expectation trends. The market is currently experiencing a **Divergence**. The crypto narrative is overwhelmingly bullish, driven by massive institutional demand ($646M ETF inflows on day one), corporate adoption (Metaplanet, BitMine staking), and geopolitical risk premium (Venezuela situation). This momentum has pushed BTC and ETH into an extremely overbought state (RSI generally above 75) with high leverage (high funding rates). The neutral liquidity backdrop against this powerful narrative creates short-term instability. While long-term fundamentals remain robust due to institutional flows, a deleveraging event or sharp correction is highly probable to reset crowded positioning. Caution is advised at current stretched levels.
